title: Person: Father Arnall
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Father Arnall

anchor.prefix: little silk badge with the white rose on it that was pinned on the breast of his jacket began to flutter. He was no good at sums but he tried his best so that York might not lose.
anchor.suffix:
’s face looked very black but he was not in a wax: he was laughing. Then Jack Lawton cracked his fingers and Father Arnall looked at his copybook and said:

 —Right. Bravo Lancaste
